title: TechnologyInterface
description: TOGAF-sourced receptor archetype — the access point where technology services are made available to the environment. A port through which technology infrastructure receives commands, data, or signals. Requires GSM unsealing of Receptor to be functional as a Receptor extension. Extends Receptor with TOGAF Technology Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Technology Interface (Content Metamodel, Technology Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture, Content Framework).

interfaceLevel.description: Technology stack level at which the interface operates. TOGAF mapping: Technology Interface abstraction layer.

accessProtocol.description: Access protocol for this technology interface. TOGAF mapping: Technology Interface protocol.
